styles.name: Clean
styles.prompt: Fix punctuation, capitalization and obvious recognition errors. Remove filler words, false starts and repetitions. When the speaker corrects themselves ("Tuesday, no, Wednesday"), keep only the correction. Keep the speaker's wording, tone and language otherwise. Format spoken lists as lists when clearly intended.

styles.name: Message
styles.prompt: Casual chat message. Keep it short and natural, conversational tone, light punctuation. No greeting or sign-off unless spoken. Use normal sentence capitalization.

styles.name: Email
styles.prompt: Well-structured email body: clear paragraphs, a greeting and sign-off only if spoken, professional but friendly tone. Do not invent content or a subject line.

styles.name: Notes
styles.prompt: Organized notes in Markdown: short headings or bullet points where the content is list-like, concise phrasing, keep every fact the speaker said.

styles.name: AI prompt / code
styles.prompt: The text is an instruction for an AI assistant or a technical note in a code editor or terminal. Make it clear and precise. Preserve technical terms, file names, identifiers, commands and code exactly; format code identifiers in `backticks` when obvious. Do not answer or execute the request.

styles.name: Formal
styles.prompt: Polished, formal written prose suitable for documents. Complete sentences, precise wording, no contractions or slang. Preserve all meaning.

templates.name: General meeting
templates.description: Summary, key points, decisions, action items
templates.prompt:
Sections:
## Summary
2–4 sentences on purpose and outcome.
## Key points
Grouped by topic, using the user's notes as the outline.
## Decisions
## Action items
- [ ] Owner — task (due date if mentioned)
## Open questions
Omit any section that would be empty.

Sections:
## Updates
## Wins
## Blockers & concerns
## Feedback
Attribute who gave feedback to whom.
## Career & growth
## Follow-ups
- [ ] Owner — task
Omit empty sections. Keep it candid and concise.

templates.name: Standup
templates.prompt:
For each person who spoke, a heading with their name (or Me / Them) and bullets:
**Done**, **Next**, **Blockers**.
Finish with ## Team blockers and ## Follow-ups. Very concise.

templates.name: Customer call
templates.description: Pains, quotes, product signals, next steps
templates.prompt:
Sections:
## Context
Who they are, their role and company, why we spoke.
## Problems in their words
Include short verbatim quotes in quotation marks.
## Current workaround
## Product signals & feature requests
## Objections / risks
## Next steps
- [ ] Owner — task (date)

templates.name: Interview
templates.prompt:
Sections:
## Candidate summary
## Experience highlights
## Strengths
## Concerns
## Notable answers
Short paraphrases with timestamps if useful.
## Recommendation
Only if the interviewer expressed one; otherwise list what evidence is still missing.

templates.name: Brainstorm
templates.prompt:
Sections:
## Goal
## Ideas
Group related ideas under themes; note who proposed each when clear.
## Favorites & why
## Parked ideas
## Next steps

templates.name: Lecture / talk
templates.description: Study notes with concepts and examples
templates.prompt: Write study notes: ## Overview, then a section per major concept with definitions, explanations and examples given, then ## Key takeaways and ## Questions to review.

recipes.name: Write follow-up email
recipes.prompt: Draft a concise follow-up email to the other participants: thank them, recap decisions, list action items with owners and dates, and propose next steps. Plain text, ready to paste.

recipes.name: List action items
recipes.prompt: List every action item as a Markdown checklist: `- [ ] Owner — task (due date)`. Include implicit commitments ("I'll send that over"). Group by owner.

recipes.name: Executive summary
recipes.prompt: Write a 5-bullet executive summary for someone who missed the meeting: outcome, decisions, risks, asks, next steps.

recipes.name: Decision log
recipes.prompt: Extract every decision made, with the reasoning given and any alternatives that were rejected. Table: Decision | Why | Alternatives rejected | Owner.

recipes.name: Open questions
recipes.prompt: List unresolved questions and disagreements, who raised them, and what would resolve them.

recipes.name: Coach me
recipes.prompt: Give me candid feedback on how I ("Me") communicated in this meeting: clarity, listening, talk-time balance, and two specific things to do better next time, citing moments from the transcript.
